card.name: Duplicate products with the same drug
card.fires_on: Words in warnings about taking two products with the same active ingredient, such as "more than one product" containing acetaminophen. Also fires inside azathioprine when it is listed next to a similar drug that should not be combined.

modes.label: More than one product
modes.description: Words in "more than one (acetaminophen-containing) product" warnings about doubling up on the same ingredient.
modes.example: Instruct patients to look for acetaminophen or APAP on package labels and not to use more than one<< product>> that contains acetaminophen.

modes.label: Overlapping immunosuppressants
modes.description: Inside azathioprine when it is named as a drug not to be given together with a similar drug.
modes.example: it is recommended that mycophenolic acid delayed-release tablets not be administered concomitantly with az<<athi>>oprine or MMF.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about overlap and redundancy, such as overlapping, redundant and unnecessary.
card.plain: It marks warnings about taking two products that contain the same or a similar drug, which would duplicate it.
